headline: The 5 Things You Need To Know Today
subhead: A quick look at the global markets, the new AI regulations, and why your coffee is getting more expensive.
author: Vox Staff

content.text: 1. European Union passes the Artificial Intelligence Act. The sweeping new legislation classifies AI systems by risk, outright banning 'unacceptable risk' applications like social scoring.
2. Global coffee yields down 14% year-over-year. An unprecedented drought in Brazil has severely impacted the Arabica bean harvest, driving up futures prices.

content.caption: Coffee fields in Minas Gerais, Brazil.

content.text: 3. SpaceX successfully lands Starship on its third attempt. The massive rocket completed a full orbital flight before touching down softly in the Gulf of Mexico.
This is a historic moment for spaceflight. Reusability at this scale fundamentally changes the economics of reaching orbit.
4. The US Federal Reserve signals another rate hike. Citing persistent inflation in the services sector, Chairman Jerome Powell indicated that rates may stay 'higher for longer'.
5. Apple announces its entry into the smart ring market. Long rumored, the 'Apple Ring' aims to provide subtle health tracking without the bulk of a watch.
